recent_posts.title: The Long-Term Cost of Technical Debt & How to Avoid It
recent_posts.summary: Technical debt is an unseen cost that can negatively impact software performance, development speed, and profitability. Taking quick shortcuts may provide immediate benefits but can lead to significant long-term drawbacks. top_posts.title: LiveView Native Is Here!
top_posts.summary: LiveView Native v0.3 provides a framework for building native UI on multiple devices using the LiveView programming model. It reduces development and maintenance costs, allows for critical updates without app store delays, and can deploy to all Apple and Android devices. Unlike other frameworks, it wraps first-class UI frameworks like SwiftUI and Jetpack, ensuring optimal user experience on each device.

top_posts.title: Why Rust is Winning in Backend Systems: A Startup Must-Know
top_posts.summary: Rust is becoming the preferred language for backend development due to its high performance, reliability, and cost-efficiency. Its speed, memory safety, and lack of garbage collection make it ideal for real-time systems, APIs, and microservices. Startups benefit from Rust’s scalability and efficiency, resulting in lower cloud costs and enhanced security. Major companies like Microsoft, AWS, and Discord already trust Rust, making it a wise choice for startups aiming to future-proof their tech stack.

top_posts.title: Creating an Accessible Toggle Switch in Tailwind CSS
top_posts.summary: Learn how to create an accessible toggle switch in Tailwind CSS using the `aria-checked` attribute and the `group` helper class. This allows for cleaner and more legible code, reducing the need for additional logic.

top_posts.title: Animate Intrinsic Size With CSS
top_posts.summary: Animating the size of UI elements with CSS has historically been challenging, especially for properties like height. Modern CSS introduces tools such as CSS Grid and the new `calc-size()` function to make these animations more seamless. CSS Grid allows replicating intrinsic-size animations, while `calc-size()` enables developers to calculate intrinsic sizes natively. While `calc-size()` has limited browser support currently, it shows great promise for future use.

top_posts.title: Introducing LVN Go
top_posts.summary: LVN Go is introduced as an alternative to Xcode for developing LiveView Native applications. This app allows developers to run their applications directly on a device without needing Xcode. It supports iPhone, iPad, and MacOS. Key features include LiveReload, a shake-to-refresh functionality, and a versatile settings menu. The post also hints at future improvements, such as tree-sitter syntax highlighters and language server integrations.
